the recurrent failures in Cloud computing environments include: 1) hardware failures (such as, disk failures, memory failures, network failures, and power failures); 2) software failures (such as software bugs, security vulnerabilities, and software misconfiguration); 3) application failures (such as application bugs, security vulnerabilities in applications, and application misconfiguration); and 4) user-related failures (such as human errors and intentional failures).
